clips.title: The story
paras: This errand introduces Alliance adventurers from the Eastern Kingdoms to the untamed continent of Kalimdor. Directed by the enthusiastic recruiter Red Jack Flint in Menethil Harbor, travelers take ship across the Great Sea to report to his high elf contact, Fiora Longears, in the inn of Theramore.

For many humans, dwarves, and gnomes, the Eastern Kingdoms feel fraught with old conflicts and scarred earth. In the bustling port of Menethil Harbor, the sailor Red Jack Flint spends his days urging adventurous travelers to board a vessel bound across the Great Sea. Describing Kalimdor as an uncharted realm of fortune and opportunity, Flint directs bold wanderers to Theramore to meet his associate, an elf named Fiora Longears.

Crossing the ocean brings travelers to Theramore, an Alliance port on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Waiting in the town inn, Fiora Longears receives arrivals recommended by Flint. Trusting Flint's eye for character, Fiora welcomes newly arrived Alliance heroes and prepares to direct them inland toward the ancient forests of Ashenvale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, to be at sea once again! To feel the kiss of the wind, and to have the waves rock me like my blessed mother, long ago!
Oh, I wish I had your fortune, good adventurer, for I see the sea in your future!

It's my job to tell eager souls of the land of Kalimdor, the land of opportunity! If you're willing to try your luck across the sea, then take a ship from here to the lovely port of Theramore. Speak there with my partner, the elf, Fiora Longears.
She'll start you on your Kalimdor adventure!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good day to you! You were sent by Mr. Flint in Menethil Harbor? Well Mr. Flint is a strong judge of character. If he sent you, then there's no doubt you belong here in Kalimdor!
